fields.Name: T348 - Restore History Filter and Expand Detail
fields.Description: Exercises the restore-card ToggleExpand detail grid and the status-chip filter popover unique to VersionHistoryRestoreResource (loads MJ: Version Label Restores with progress bars/error log) — a code path not shared with the other surfaces.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → 'Restore History' (left nav), confirm four KPI cards (Total Restores, Successful, Failed, Partial) and a Filters popover with status chips. If restore rows exist, click one to expand it and confirm a detail grid (Status, Items Completed, Items Failed) appears; if none exist confirm the empty state. Apply a status filter from the popover and confirm the list responds. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Restore History shows the four KPI cards and a status Filters control
Expanding a restore row reveals a detail grid (Status/Items Completed/Items Failed), or a valid empty state if there are no restores
Applying a status filter narrows the list or shows a no-results state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
